Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Order processor Lambda function triggered by SQS queue

Parameters:
  FunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: order-processor
    Description: Name of the Lambda function
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]
  MessageRetentionPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Default: 345600
    MinValue: 60
    MaxValue: 1209600
  VisibilityTimeoutSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 180
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 43200

Resources:
  OrderProcessorDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${FunctionName}-dlq'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: true

  OrderProcessorQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${FunctionName}-queue'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !Ref MessageRetentionPeriod
      VisibilityTimeout: !Ref VisibilityTimeoutSeconds
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: true
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt OrderProcessorDLQ.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  OrderProcessorQueuePolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Properties:
      Queues:
        - !Ref OrderProcessorQueue
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 'sqs:*'
            Resource: !GetAtt OrderProcessorQueue.Arn
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  OrderProcessorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${FunctionName}-role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SQSConsumeAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                Resource: !GetAtt OrderProcessorQueue.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                Resource: !GetAtt OrderProcessorDLQ.Arn
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt OrderProcessorLogGroup.Arn

  OrderProcessorLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${FunctionName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  OrderProcessorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: OrderProcessorLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref FunctionName
      Description: Processes order messages from SQS
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt OrderProcessorRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 30
      ReservedConcurrentExecutions: 10
      Architectures:
        - arm64
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_LEVEL: INFO
          QUEUE_URL: !Ref OrderProcessorQueue
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import os

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(os.environ.get("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO"))


          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              batch_item_failures = []
              records = event.get("Records", [])
              logger.info("Received %d messages", len(records))

              for record in records:
                  message_id = record.get("messageId")
                  try:
                      body = json.loads(record["body"])
                      logger.info("Processing order %s", body.get("orderId"))
                      # TODO: implement order processing logic
                  except Exception as exc:
                      logger.exception("Failed to process message %s: %s", message_id, exc)
                      batch_item_failures.append({"itemIdentifier": message_id})

              return {"batchItemFailures": batch_item_failures}

  OrderProcessorEventSourceMapping:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::EventSourceMapping
    Properties:
      EventSourceArn: !GetAtt OrderProcessorQueue.Arn
      FunctionName: !GetAtt OrderProcessorFunction.Arn
      BatchSize: 10
      MaximumBatchingWindowInSeconds: 5
      Enabled: true
      FunctionResponseTypes:
